references.label: Raptor Pen targets and lock
references.description: The Raptor Pen bank and lock occupy the upper-left playfield.

references.label: Raptor dead-end lane
references.description: The center dead-end lane captures balls and starts Raptor Tri-Ball after fence integrity reaches zero.

references.label: Jungle Explorer truck
references.description: The center truck controls map travel and T-REX progress.

references.context: Shoot C to start the selected Control Room mode.

references.description: The C shot starts Control Room modes after the first dinosaur capture.

references.label: Supply Drop target bank
references.description: The three purple targets qualify the large Supply Drop target.

references.label: 2x playfield target
references.description: The far-right standup starts the timed 2x playfield-scoring window after Supply Drop.

references.label: Helipad shot
references.description: The Helipad is the upper-right shot used by Paddocks and System Boot combos.

references.label: Upper-flipper loop
references.description: The upper loop is the highest-value Raptor six-ball phase shot.
